title: Release 2.0.2 readiness (umbrella): ComfyUI 0.39.0 ships, MPI-1043 leftovers block the cut
description: Umbrella for the 2.0.2 release (Fabio, 2026-10-08). 2.0.2 ships the engine bump to ComfyUI 0.39.0 (MPI-1043). BLOCKERS, all must close before the cut: (1) scoped smoke of Qwen-Image 2.1 (MPI-936) + 3D scene (MPI-623) with --flows all on the v0.25.0-dev Pod image, once both graphs land; price and run count to Fabio first. (2) sync mpi-ci cubric-vision-pod/node_lock.json MpiNodes to the app pin (code-only, no rebuild). (3) clean RELEASE Pod image rebuild at v0.25.0 and move the STABLE POD_IMAGE_VERSION / _CPU pair in routes/remotePodLifecycle.js; mandatory after an engine bump, or 2.0.2 users get a 0.39.0 local engine against a 0.34.0 Pod. (4) stamp 2.0.2 with /mpi-version-bump, then /mpi-release. Details in brief.md.
